r0-context.title: Load baseline context
r0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the handoff, the diff, and the relevant packet. Record pass when loaded.

r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside allowed scope (module_uncertainty_diagnostics.py + focused tests only) and respect specific exclusions? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules and handoff constraints? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from recorded architecture or docs/contracts in a way the Pilot must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag triage if out of scope.

r6-empty-usable-flag.title: Empty usable flag
r6-empty-usable-flag.imperative: Verify empty usable event sets add a compact stable module diagnostic flag visible in JSON module entries.

r7-fully-skipped-flag.title: Fully skipped flag
r7-fully-skipped-flag.imperative: Verify fully skipped usable event sets add a compact stable module diagnostic flag visible in JSON module entries.

r8-summary-counters.title: Summary counters
r8-summary-counters.imperative: Verify matching JSON report summary counters exist and count the new diagnostic flags.

r9-normal-scored-no-flag.title: Normal scored set
r9-normal-scored-no-flag.imperative: Verify normal scored event sets are not flagged as empty or fully skipped.

r10-protected-intent.title: Protected intent
r10-protected-intent.imperative: Verify there is no change to model training, calibration math, pairwise loss, architecture, training data selection, recursive behavior, or fantasy-scoring dependencies.

r11-no-schema-docs.title: No schema doc changes
r11-no-schema-docs.imperative: Verify docs/report_schemas, ENGINE_CONFIG, and AGENT_GUIDE were not modified (g3 scope). Record pass/fail with a finding.

r12-focused-tests.title: Focused tests
r12-focused-tests.imperative: Run the required focused test command or record why not run; prefer running it.
